s: The SIXray dataset is constructed by Pattern Recognition and Intelligent System Development Laboratory, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences. The SIXray dataset contains 1,059,231 X-ray images which are collected from some several subway stations. There are six common categories of prohibited items, namely, gun, knife, wrench, pliers, scissors and hammer.
